# The bill's payment, linked by `txn_guid:` alone.
#
# The payable side of `a_payment_giving_only_the_parked_transaction.txt`, and
# the one branch of this feature no bill exercised: every other bill fixture
# here names its split or groups several, so both take a different path.
#
# It is the branch that carries the sign guard, and the sign is the thing that
# runs the other way on a bill. A payable posts negative and its settlement is
# positive, the reverse of an invoice's — the same subtlety that made a credit
# note's refund look like a swapped `account:` — so the payable direction is
# the half of that guard nothing had run.
#
# What this fixture produces: the parked split on
# `Liabilities:Accounts Payable USD` at +100.00 USD in the bill's lot, restated
# from what the bank sent, with the entry quoted USD and no CAD left in it.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_linking_a_split_not_on_the_receivable.py.
bill "BILL-USD-001"
  vendor_id: "V-US"
  currency: USD
  date_opened: 2026-01-05
  entry:
    date: 2026-01-05
    description: "Parts"
    account: "Expenses:Supplies"
    quantity: 1
    price: 100
    taxable: false
  posted:
    date: 2026-01-05
    due: 2026-02-05
    ap_account: "Liabilities:Accounts Payable USD"
    memo: "Bill BILL-USD-001"
    accumulate: true
  payment:
    date: 2026-02-25
    amount: 100
    account: "Assets:Bank:USD"
    txn_guid: "5c6d7e8f9001122334455667788a9bac"
